title: APAC pipeline hits record as AI race widens
lede: Asia-Pacific's data center development pipeline reached a record 26.5 GW in the first half of 2026, with global absorption doubling year-over-year to 25 GW, according to JLL, as AI pre-leasing tightened supply across the region. The surge played out unevenly: Johor consolidated its position as Southeast Asia's growth engine, with YTL Power and JLand planning a 1.5 GW campus and STT GDC securing US$1.37 billion in green financing, while Singapore doled out scarce new capacity through its second Data Centre Call for Application to Digital Realty, Equinix, Keppel and STT GDC. Japan's build-out pushed beyond the Tokyo-Osaka corridor, headlined by a 2 trillion yen AI campus in Akita and Goodman's 20-year hyperscaler lease in Tsukuba. South Korea paired a vast national investment program and NVIDIA's $1 billion NAVER stake with growing regulatory and community pushback, and in China, GDS raised guidance on record AI bookings as capacity shifted inland. Australia moved to ration grid access even as multi-gigawatt proposals piled up.

themes.heading: Record pipeline as AI pre-leasing tightens supply
themes.narrative: Asia-Pacific's development pipeline hit a record 26.5 GW in the first half of 2026, with AI tenants' pre-leasing squeezing available capacity across Southeast Asia, China, Japan, Korea and Australia. Globally, JLL put first-half absorption at 25 GW, roughly double the prior year and well ahead of expectations. The figures frame a market where demand, not capital, is no longer the constraint.
themes.heading_zh: AI 预租赁收紧供应，数据中心交易管线创纪录
themes.narrative_zh: 亚太地区的开发项目管线在2026年上半年达到创纪录的26.5 GW，AI租户的预租需求正在挤压东南亚、中国、日本、韩国和澳大利亚的可用容量。全球范围内，JLL测算上半年吸纳量为25 GW，约为上年同期的两倍，远超预期。这些数据勾勒出一个需求（而非资本）不再构成制约的市场格局。

themes.heading: Johor and Singapore anchor Southeast Asian growth
themes.narrative: YTL Power and JLand announced plans for a data center campus of up to 1.5 GW in Johor, among the largest proposed in Southeast Asia, while STT GDC secured up to US$1.37 billion in green financing for its flagship Johor campus. In Singapore, the government awarded 50 MW each to Digital Realty, Equinix, Keppel and STT GDC under its second capacity call-for-application, and Digital Realty separately outlined a 50 MW AI-focused facility on Jurong Island. DayOne added a SGD 530 million green loan for a hydrogen-powered proof-of-concept site in the city-state.
themes.heading_zh: 柔佛与新加坡引领东南亚增长
themes.narrative_zh: YTL Power与JLand宣布计划在柔佛建设最高1.5 GW的数据中心园区，为东南亚拟建规模最大的项目之一；与此同时，STT GDC为其柔佛旗舰园区获得最高13.7亿美元的绿色融资。在新加坡，政府在第二轮容量征集申请中向Digital Realty、Equinix、Keppel和STT GDC各授予50 MW，Digital Realty另公布在裕廊岛建设一座50 MW的AI专用设施。DayOne新增一笔5.3亿新元的绿色贷款，用于在新加坡建设氢能驱动的概念验证站点。

themes.heading: Japan's build-out spreads beyond the capital
themes.narrative: Akita Prefecture is set to host what would be Japan's largest AI data center, a project estimated at around 2 trillion yen (roughly US$12.6-13 billion) and backed by offshore wind power. Closer to Tokyo, Goodman signed a 20-year lease with a global hyperscaler for the first 50 MW phase of its planned 1 GW Tsukuba campus, with power secured from TEPCO. An NTT-backed consortium meanwhile targeted Ishikari in Hokkaido as a new hub, underscoring the shift toward northern regions with land, power and cooler climates.
themes.heading_zh: 日本的建设热潮扩展至首都圈之外
themes.narrative_zh: 秋田县将承接日本最大的AI数据中心，该项目估算投资约2万亿日元（约合126至130亿美元），并由海上风电提供电力支撑。在离东京更近的地方，Goodman就其规划中的1 GW筑波园区首期50 MW与一家全球hyperscaler签署了20年租约，电力已从TEPCO获得保障。与此同时，一个由NTT支持的财团将目光投向北海道石狩，拟将其打造为新枢纽，凸显出行业向拥有土地、电力资源和更凉爽气候的北部地区转移的趋势。

themes.heading: Korea scales AI capacity amid local pushback
themes.narrative: South Korea launched a data center investment program cited at 1,200 trillion won to localize AI infrastructure, and NVIDIA committed $1 billion to NAVER to expand domestic AI capacity, while Alibaba Cloud opened its third Korean facility. Korean telecom operators collectively passed 1 trillion won in AI data center sales, underlining their growing role as infrastructure providers. The boom is meeting resistance: Seoul residents are opposing new facilities near neighborhoods, and policymakers are calling for tighter regulation over power use and siting.
themes.heading_zh: 韩国在本地反对声中扩大 AI 容量
themes.narrative_zh: 韩国启动了一项据称规模达1,200万亿韩元的数据中心投资计划，以推动AI基础设施本土化；NVIDIA承诺向NAVER投资10亿美元以扩大韩国本土AI算力，阿里云则在韩国开设了第三座设施。韩国电信运营商的AI数据中心销售额合计突破1万亿韩元，凸显其作为基础设施提供商的角色日益增强。这轮热潮正遭遇阻力：首尔居民反对在社区附近新建数据中心，政策制定者也在呼吁对用电和选址实施更严格的监管。

themes.heading: China demand lifts GDS as capacity shifts inland
themes.narrative: GDS Holdings raised its full-year revenue and EBITDA guidance on strengthening AI demand and record bookings, sending its shares up 7.6% and prompting analyst suggestions the stock could be a third undervalued. Surging AI computing needs are pushing Chinese tech giants toward Inner Mongolia, drawn by energy resources and a cooler climate, redistributing capacity away from coastal hubs. Separately, TechInsights examined whether China can deliver competitive datacenter AI performance without NVIDIA GPUs, framing domestic chip capability as a $100 billion question.
themes.heading_zh: 中国需求提振 GDS，产能向内陆转移
themes.narrative_zh: 万国数据（GDS Holdings）因AI需求走强和预订量创纪录而上调全年营收和EBITDA指引，推动股价上涨7.6%，并引发分析师认为该股可能仍被低估三分之一的观点。激增的AI算力需求正推动中国科技巨头向内蒙古转移，当地能源资源和更凉爽的气候是主要吸引力，容量正从沿海枢纽重新分布。另外，TechInsights分析了中国能否在不使用NVIDIA GPU的情况下提供有竞争力的数据中心AI性能，将国产芯片能力称为一个价值1,000亿美元的问题。

themes.heading: Australia races to match grid with gigawatt ambitions
themes.narrative: Centuria and ResetData fast-tracked a 250 MW AI pipeline with A$165 million in GPU financing and a A$300 million equity raise, alongside a 7 MW capacity agreement with CDC Data Centres and a Macquarie bridge facility. Macquarie was also reported to be eyeing Stack Infrastructure's APAC portfolio, valued above $25 billion, while Singapore-based Zerra DC filed plans for a 1.44 GW campus in Queensland. Transgrid introduced a six-part readiness test before granting grid capacity to large loads, and a federal minister outlined ambitions to convert the investment boom into sovereign AI capability.
themes.heading_zh: 澳大利亚加速电网建设以匹配千兆瓦级雄心
themes.narrative_zh: Centuria与ResetData加速推进250 MW的AI项目管线，获得1.65亿澳元的GPU融资并完成3亿澳元的股权融资，同时与CDC Data Centres签署7 MW容量协议，并获得Macquarie的过桥融资。另有报道称Macquarie正关注Stack Infrastructure的亚太资产组合，估值超过250亿美元；总部位于新加坡的Zerra DC提交了在昆士兰建设1.44 GW园区的规划。Transgrid推出六部分就绪测试，作为向大型负荷授予电网容量的前置条件；一位联邦部长则阐述了将投资热潮转化为主权AI能力的愿景。
